notes: The supplied artifact is the real one: `ball_male_17mm.stl`, the 17 mm male ball the user had already printed and used, resolved through `tools/fixtures.py` so its size and SHA-256 are verified before the job sees it -- the same bytes the `vent-ball-combine-r1` run consumed. The request is that run's own recorded request. The edit, the proposal and the two recorded review judgements were authored for this replay; the run itself was not replayed, and this module's docstring gives the four reasons. What this case exercises that nothing else in the repository does: a MODIFY job with a declared edit scope, a preservation row inside the frozen acceptance contract, and a two-review round trip answered entirely from a recording -- pause, answer, pause, answer, finish. It runs with `--no-render` so that a machine with pyrender installed and one without record the same witness, which is also why both recorded judgements say they saw no images: on this lane they did not.
